$comment: Result vocabulary: the registry of obligation types a rule can impose. Every rule's result names one obligation code and supplies its typed params. 'behaviors' lists the engine result types the obligation may use; 'kronto' says what a scheduler should do when the rule fires (block the schedule, compute a premium, or inform). 'compareParam' is the parameter the evaluator uses to pick the most protective rule when several of the same obligation fire; for minimum_required_value obligations 'targetFact' names the scenario fact that is compared against it.

units.hours_pay: Hours of pay at the employee's rate
units.multiplier: Multiple of the regular rate (1.5 = time and a half)
units.hour_of_day: Hour of the day, 0-24, local time

obligations.name: Minimum wage
obligations.description: The lowest hourly rate an employer may pay a covered employee.

params.name: rate
params.description: Minimum hourly rate

obligations.name: Paid sick leave accrual
obligations.description: Sick (or safe) leave the employee accrues per hour worked, with a yearly cap.

params.name: annual_cap_hours
params.description: Hours of leave the employee must be able to accrue (or use) per year

params.name: hours_worked_per_hour_accrued
params.description: Hours worked to accrue one hour of leave (30 means 1 hour per 30 worked)

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the leave is paid

obligations.name: Family and medical leave entitlement
obligations.description: Weeks of job-protected family or medical leave the employee is entitled to in a benefit year.

params.name: weeks
params.description: Weeks of leave available

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the leave is paid (state insurance programs) or unpaid (federal FMLA)

obligations.name: Meal break
obligations.description: An uninterrupted meal period owed once a shift reaches a given length.

params.name: minimum_minutes
params.description: Minimum length of the meal period

params.name: after_hours
params.description: Shift length at which the meal period is owed

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the meal period must be paid (usually false)

obligations.name: Rest break
obligations.description: A short paid rest period owed for each block of hours worked.

params.name: minimum_minutes
params.description: Minimum length of each rest period

params.name: per_hours_worked
params.description: One rest period is owed per this many hours worked (or major fraction)

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the rest period is paid (usually true)

obligations.name: Lactation break
obligations.description: Reasonable break time, as often as needed, for an employee to express breast milk, with a private space other than a bathroom.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the break time itself must be paid (false = unpaid unless taken during an existing paid break)

params.name: duration_months
params.description: How long after the child's birth the right lasts, in months (federal: 12); omitted when the law sets no limit

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches, where the law sets one

params.name: hardship_exemption_under
params.description: Employers below this size may claim undue hardship (federal: 50)

params.name: concurrent_with_breaks
params.description: True when the law only guarantees the right to express milk during breaks the employee already has

params.name: minimum_minutes
params.description: Paid minutes per break where the law sets a figure (New York: 30)

obligations.name: Voting leave
obligations.description: Time off to vote on election day when the employee's schedule leaves too little non-working time while polls are open.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the time off must be paid

params.name: hours
params.description: Maximum hours of leave the employee may take; omitted where the law says 'as necessary'

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Advance notice the employer may require, in days (0 = must be requested before election day)

params.name: nonworking_hours_exception
params.description: No leave is owed when the employee has at least this many consecutive non-working hours while polls are open

params.name: employer_sets_time
params.description: Whether the employer may designate when the leave is taken

obligations.name: Jury duty leave
obligations.description: Job-protected leave for jury service; some states require the employer to pay for part of it or bar scheduling the employee around the service day.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the employer must pay regular wages during service (less any jury fee where the law allows)

params.name: paid_days
params.description: Days of service the pay duty covers; omitted when unlimited

params.name: daily_cap_usd
params.description: Cap on the daily pay owed, where the law sets one

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the pay duty attaches

params.name: full_time_only
params.description: Whether only full-time employees are owed pay

params.name: no_work_within_hours
params.description: The employer may not require work within this many hours of the time the employee must report for service

params.name: night_shift_ban
params.description: The employer may not require work between 5 p.m. and 3 a.m. on a day the employee served 4 or more hours

obligations.name: Workweek and workday definition
obligations.description: The fixed, regularly recurring period over which overtime hours are counted; it may start on any day and hour but cannot be moved to avoid overtime.

params.name: period_hours
params.description: Length of the workweek in hours (168 = seven consecutive 24-hour periods)

params.name: workday_hours
params.description: Length of the workday where daily overtime applies (24 consecutive hours)

params.name: fixed_recurring
params.description: The period must be fixed and regularly recurring; changes are allowed only if permanent and not designed to evade overtime

obligations.name: Overtime premium
obligations.description: A multiple of the regular rate owed for hours past a daily or weekly threshold.

params.name: multiplier
params.description: Multiple of the regular rate (1.5, 2)

params.name: threshold_hours
params.description: Hours after which the premium applies

params.name: period
params.description: Whether the threshold is per workday, per workweek, or applies to hours worked on the seventh consecutive day of the workweek

obligations.name: Schedule change premium
obligations.description: Predictability pay owed when the employer changes a posted schedule inside the notice window.

params.name: amount
params.description: Premium amount, in the unit given

params.name: unit
params.description: How the amount is expressed: hours of pay per affected shift, a flat dollar amount, or a percent of the subtracted hours

params.name: notice_window_days
params.description: Changes made with less than this much notice trigger the premium

params.name: change_type
params.description: Which schedule changes trigger the premium: hours added (incl. added shifts), hours reduced (incl. cancellations and early send-home), a time or location change with no change in hours, an on-call shift the employee was not called in for, or any change

obligations.name: Advance schedule notice
obligations.description: The schedule must be posted at least this far ahead of the first shift on it.

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Minimum days between posting and the first shift (72 hours = 3)

obligations.name: Rest between shifts (clopening)
obligations.description: A closing shift followed by an opening shift with less than the required rest is barred, or owes a premium, unless the employee consents.

params.name: rest_hours
params.description: Minimum hours between the end of one shift and the start of the next

params.name: amount
params.description: Premium amount, in the unit given

params.name: unit
params.description: How the premium is expressed

obligations.name: Good faith estimate of hours
obligations.description: At hire (and on request or when circumstances change) the employer must give a written good faith estimate of the employee's expected hours, days and shifts.

params.name: lookback_days
params.description: Period the estimate is based on or must be revisited over, where the law sets one (Philadelphia and Chicago: 90 days)

obligations.name: Right to decline late-added hours
obligations.description: The employee may refuse hours or shifts the employer adds or moves inside the notice window; working them needs the employee's consent.

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Hours added with less than this much notice may be declined

obligations.name: Offer of hours to existing employees
obligations.description: Before hiring new staff or using a staffing agency to cover hours, the employer must offer those hours to existing (part-time) employees.

params.name: offer_window_hours
params.description: How long the offer must stay open to existing employees before the employer may hire (72 hours = 3 days)

params.name: max_part_time_hours
params.description: Weekly hours below which an employee counts as part-time for the offer, where the law sets one

synonyms: offer of work to existing employees

obligations.name: Late schedule change ban
obligations.description: The employer may not make the named kind of schedule change inside the notice window at all (not merely owe a premium), unless the employee consents in writing where the law allows it.

params.name: notice_hours
params.description: Changes with less than this many hours of notice are barred

params.name: change_type
params.description: Which change is barred

obligations.name: On-call scheduling ban
obligations.description: The employer may not require the employee to be available without scheduling and paying them.

obligations.name: Reporting time pay
obligations.description: Minimum pay owed when an employee reports for a scheduled shift and is sent home early or not put to work.

params.name: minimum_hours
params.description: Minimum hours that must be paid

params.name: maximum_hours
params.description: Cap on the hours owed under the rule

params.name: fraction_of_scheduled
params.description: Fraction of the scheduled shift that must be paid (0.5 = half)

params.name: rate_basis
params.description: Which rate the hours are paid at

obligations.name: Split shift premium
obligations.description: Extra pay owed when the workday is split by an unpaid, non-meal gap.

params.name: amount
params.description: Hours of pay owed

params.name: rate_basis
params.description: Which rate the premium is paid at

obligations.name: Spread of hours premium
obligations.description: Extra pay owed when the span from the first to the last hour of the workday exceeds a threshold.

params.name: amount
params.description: Hours of pay owed

params.name: spread_hours
params.description: Workday span that triggers the premium

params.name: rate_basis
params.description: Which rate the premium is paid at

obligations.name: Weekly day of rest
obligations.description: The employee must get a day (24 consecutive hours) of rest in each week or run of consecutive days.

params.name: max_consecutive_days
params.description: Most consecutive days the employee may be scheduled

params.name: rest_hours
params.description: Consecutive hours of rest owed in each period

params.name: period_days
params.description: Length of the period the rest is owed in (usually 7)

obligations.name: Minor work-hour curfew
obligations.description: Earliest start or latest end time a minor may work, often differing on school nights.

params.name: age_min
params.description: Youngest age covered

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

params.name: latest_end_hour
params.description: Work must end by this hour (21 = 9 PM; 24 and above means after midnight)

params.name: earliest_start_hour
params.description: Work may not start before this hour

params.name: school_night
params.description: True when the limit applies only before a school day, false when it applies only outside the school year; omitted when it applies always

obligations.name: Minor daily hours limit
obligations.description: Most hours a minor may work in one day.

params.name: age_min
params.description: Youngest age covered

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

params.name: max_hours
params.description: Maximum hours in the day

params.name: school_day
params.description: True for school days, false for non-school days; omitted when it applies always

obligations.name: Minor weekly hours limit
obligations.description: Most hours a minor may work in one week.

params.name: age_min
params.description: Youngest age covered

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

params.name: max_hours
params.description: Maximum hours in the week

params.name: school_week
params.description: True for weeks when school is in session, false for non-school weeks; omitted when it applies always

obligations.name: Minor employment restrictions (general)
obligations.description: A state's child labor law summarized as one rule: work permits, hazardous occupations and hour limits not yet split into separate rules.

params.name: age_max
params.description: Oldest age covered

obligations.name: Mass layoff / plant closing notice (WARN)
obligations.description: Advance written notice owed to employees and the state before a plant closing or mass layoff.

params.name: notice_days
params.description: Days of advance notice required

params.name: employee_threshold
params.description: Employer size (or affected count) at which the law applies

obligations.name: Mandatory overtime ban
obligations.description: The employer may not require the employee to work beyond the agreed, predetermined shift (or past a stated hour cap) without the employee's consent, outside a genuine emergency. Mostly nurse and health care facility laws.

params.name: max_shift_hours
params.description: Most consecutive hours the employee may be required to work in a shift or 24-hour period

params.name: max_hours_per_period
params.description: Most hours the employee may be required to work in the period

params.name: period_days
params.description: Length of the period max_hours_per_period applies to (7 = workweek, 14 = two weeks)

params.name: rest_hours_after
params.description: Consecutive off-duty hours owed after a long shift

params.name: rest_after_hours
params.description: Shift length that triggers rest_hours_after

params.name: emergency_exception
params.description: Whether an unforeseeable emergency lets the employer require the hours anyway

params.name: cba_exception
params.description: Whether a collective bargaining agreement that addresses mandatory overtime displaces the ban

obligations.name: Maximum hours of work
obligations.description: A statutory ceiling on hours an employer may require (or allow) an adult employee to work in a day, week or longer period.

params.name: max_daily_hours
params.description: Most hours that may be worked in a day

params.name: max_weekly_hours
params.description: Most hours that may be required in a workweek

params.name: consent_max_weekly_hours
params.description: Weekly ceiling that applies even with the employee's written consent

params.name: max_overtime_hours
params.description: Most overtime hours (over 40 a week) that may be required in the period

params.name: period_days
params.description: Length of the period the cap applies to

params.name: emergency_exception
params.description: Whether an emergency lets the employer exceed the cap

obligations.name: Right to request schedule changes
obligations.description: The employee may ask for changes to hours, days, times, location or a flexible or predictable arrangement without retaliation; some laws also oblige the employer to consider, answer in writing, or grant the request absent a business reason.

params.name: must_grant_unless_business_reason
params.description: Whether the employer must grant the request unless it has a bona fide business reason or undue hardship (false = consider or respond only)

params.name: written_response_days
params.description: Days the employer has to answer in writing

params.name: requests_per_year
params.description: Requests the employer must entertain per year

params.name: retaliation_only
params.description: True when the law only bars retaliation for asking

obligations.name: Meal period waiver or on-duty meal
obligations.description: Whether and how a required meal period may be waived, shortened or taken on duty.

params.name: waiver_allowed
params.description: Whether the employee may waive the meal period at all

params.name: max_shift_hours_for_waiver
params.description: Longest shift on which the waiver is valid

params.name: written_agreement_required
params.description: Whether the waiver must be in writing

params.name: revocable
params.description: Whether the employee may revoke the waiver

params.name: on_duty_meal_allowed
params.description: Whether a paid on-duty meal may replace the duty-free period when the nature of the work requires it

params.name: second_meal
params.description: True when the rule is about the second meal period

obligations.name: Exempt salary threshold
obligations.description: The lowest weekly salary at which an executive, administrative or professional employee may be treated as exempt from overtime; below it the employee is owed overtime regardless of duties.

params.name: weekly_salary
params.description: Minimum weekly salary for the exemption

params.name: annual_salary
params.description: The same threshold expressed per year

params.name: basis
params.description: How the figure is set (fixed, multiple of the minimum wage, indexed)

obligations.name: Sunday and holiday premium
obligations.description: A multiple of the regular rate owed for hours worked on a Sunday or an enumerated legal holiday, independent of overtime.

params.name: multiplier
params.description: Multiple of the regular rate owed for the premium hours

params.name: applies_sunday
params.description: Whether Sunday hours earn the premium

params.name: applies_holidays
params.description: Whether hours on the enumerated legal holidays earn the premium

params.name: holidays
params.description: The enumerated holidays, comma separated

params.name: right_to_refuse
params.description: Whether the employee may refuse Sunday or holiday work without penalty

params.name: excluded_from_weekly_overtime
params.description: Whether premium hours are left out when computing weekly overtime

obligations.name: Paid sick leave usage rules
obligations.description: When accrued sick leave may first be used, the smallest increment the employee may take, and any cap on hours used per year.

params.name: waiting_period_days
params.description: Calendar days of employment before accrued leave may be used (0 = usable as accrued)

params.name: waiting_period_hours_worked
params.description: Hours of employment before accrual (and use) begins, where the law counts hours rather than days

params.name: max_increment_hours
params.description: Largest minimum-use increment the employer may impose

params.name: increment_follows_payroll
params.description: Whether the increment must be the smallest one the payroll system tracks (subject to max_increment_hours)

params.name: annual_use_cap_hours
params.description: Most hours the employer may limit use to per year

obligations.name: Paid sick leave carryover and payout
obligations.description: Whether unused sick leave carries into the next year, any cap on carryover or total balance, whether frontloading removes the duty, and payout at separation or rehire reinstatement.

params.name: carryover_required
params.description: Whether unused accrued leave must carry over to the next year

params.name: carryover_cap_hours
params.description: Most hours the employer may limit carryover to

params.name: balance_cap_hours
params.description: Most hours the employer may cap the total accrued balance at

params.name: frontload_avoids_carryover
params.description: Whether granting the full annual amount at the start of the year removes the carryover duty

params.name: payout_in_lieu_allowed
params.description: Whether the employer may pay out unused leave at year end instead of carrying it over

params.name: payout_at_separation_required
params.description: Whether unused sick leave must be paid out when employment ends

params.name: rehire_reinstatement_months
params.description: Months after separation within which a rehired employee gets the unused balance back

obligations.name: Domestic violence, safe and crime victim leave
obligations.description: Job-protected time off for an employee (or family member) who is a victim of domestic violence, sexual assault, stalking or another crime, for court, medical, counseling, relocation or safety needs; some laws instead require reasonable accommodation.

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the employer must pay for the leave (false = unpaid, or paid only at the employer's option or from accrued paid leave)

params.name: max_days
params.description: Most days of leave per period, where the law sets a cap

params.name: max_hours
params.description: Most hours of leave per period, where the law counts hours

params.name: max_weeks
params.description: Most weeks of leave per period, where the law counts weeks

params.name: period_months
params.description: Length of the period the cap applies to, in months (12 = per year)

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches

params.name: tenure_days
params.description: Days of employment before the employee is eligible

params.name: family_member_covered
params.description: Whether leave is also owed when a family or household member is the victim

params.name: court_proceedings_only
params.description: True when the law covers only attendance at court or legal proceedings (crime victim leave)

params.name: accommodation_required
params.description: True when the law requires reasonable safety accommodations (schedule changes, transfer) rather than or in addition to a leave entitlement

params.name: covered_reasons
params.description: Purposes the leave may be used for

obligations.name: Military service leave
obligations.description: Unpaid leave and reemployment rights for an employee called to uniformed or state military service, training or drills (USERRA and state National Guard laws).

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the employer must pay during the leave (false under USERRA and all state laws)

params.name: covers_state_active_duty
params.description: Whether the law protects state-ordered (Governor-called) National Guard or militia duty, which USERRA does not

params.name: reinstatement_required
params.description: Whether the employee must be restored to the same or an escalator position on return

params.name: max_cumulative_years
params.description: Cumulative years of service after which reemployment rights end

params.name: annual_training_leave_days
params.description: Days of leave per year the law guarantees for drills, encampments or training

params.name: no_discharge_without_cause_months
params.description: Months after return during which the employee may be discharged only for cause

params.name: health_continuation_days
params.description: Days the employer must keep health coverage in force at its own expense

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches

params.name: service_type
params.description: Service the rule covers (uniformed services, state active duty, civil air patrol)

obligations.name: Military family leave
obligations.description: Unpaid leave for the spouse, parent or other family member of a service member who is deployed, on leave from deployment, injured or killed on active duty.

params.name: max_days
params.description: Most days of leave per deployment or per year

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the leave must be paid (false everywhere today)

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches

params.name: min_hours_per_week
params.description: Weekly hours the employee must average to be eligible

params.name: tenure_months
params.description: Months of employment required

params.name: tenure_hours
params.description: Hours worked in the prior 12 months required

params.name: deployment_days_min
params.description: Minimum length of the service member's orders for the leave to apply

params.name: covered_relationships
params.description: Family members whose service triggers the leave

params.name: trigger
params.description: Event the leave attaches to (deployment, leave from deployment, injury, death, ceremony)

obligations.name: Vacation and PTO payout at separation
obligations.description: Whether accrued, unused vacation or paid time off must be paid as final wages when employment ends, and whether use-it-or-lose-it forfeiture is allowed.

params.name: payout_required
params.description: always = statute requires payout; unless_written_policy = owed unless a written policy or agreement says otherwise; policy_only = owed only when the employer's policy or contract promises it; not_required = no state duty

params.name: forfeiture_prohibited
params.description: Whether use-it-or-lose-it forfeiture of accrued vacation is barred (accrual caps may still be allowed)

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches

params.name: tenure_years
params.description: Years of service before payout is owed

params.name: notice_required_for_forfeiture
params.description: Whether a forfeiture or no-payout policy must be in writing and disclosed in advance to be enforceable

obligations.name: Bereavement leave
obligations.description: Job-protected time off after the death of a family member (or a pregnancy or reproductive loss where the law covers it).

params.name: max_days
params.description: Days of leave per death or per year

params.name: paid
params.description: Whether the leave itself must be paid (false = unpaid, though accrued paid leave may be used)

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the duty attaches

params.name: tenure_days
params.description: Days of employment required

params.name: tenure_hours
params.description: Hours worked in the prior 12 months required

params.name: window_days
params.description: Days after the death within which the leave must be taken

params.name: annual_cap_days
params.description: Most days per year across all deaths

params.name: uses_accrued_leave
params.description: True when the law only lets the employee apply accrued paid leave rather than granting new leave

params.name: covered_relationships
params.description: Family members whose death triggers the leave

obligations.name: Final paycheck deadline
obligations.description: When all wages earned through separation must be paid, which usually differs for a discharge and a resignation.

params.name: deadline
params.description: Shape of the deadline; no_state_law means only the FLSA next-regular-payday practice applies

params.name: hours
params.description: Hours after separation (or after demand) when deadline is within_hours

params.name: days
params.description: Days after separation when the deadline counts days

params.name: business_days
params.description: Whether the day count excludes weekends and holidays

params.name: runs_from_demand
params.description: Whether the clock starts at the employee's demand for payment rather than at separation

params.name: notice_shortens_deadline
params.description: How advance notice from the employee changes the deadline

params.name: penalty
params.description: Statutory penalty for late payment

obligations.name: Pay frequency
obligations.description: How often wages must be paid and how soon after the pay period ends; many states let exempt or salaried staff be paid less often.

params.name: minimum_frequency
params.description: Least frequent lawful pay schedule for the employees the rule covers; none means the state sets no frequency

params.name: max_days_between_paydays
params.description: Longest lawful gap between paydays where the statute counts days

params.name: max_lag_days
params.description: Days after the end of a pay period by which wages for that period must be paid

params.name: lag_business_days
params.description: Whether max_lag_days counts business days only

params.name: exempt_may_be_monthly
params.description: Whether exempt, executive, administrative or professional employees may be paid monthly

params.name: applies_to
params.description: Who the frequency rule covers when narrower than all employees

params.name: notes
params.description: Waivers, agency approvals and other wrinkles

obligations.name: Wage deductions
obligations.description: What an employer may take out of a paycheck beyond taxes and court orders, whether the employee must authorize it in writing, and whether cash shortages, breakage or damage may ever be charged back.

params.name: written_authorization_required
params.description: What the employee must sign (or be told) before a voluntary deduction; not_required means the state has no general consent statute and only the FLSA floor applies

params.name: shortage_damage_deductions
params.description: Whether cash shortages, breakage, lost or damaged property may be deducted and on what condition

params.name: below_minimum_wage_prohibited
params.description: Whether employer-benefit deductions may never reduce pay below the minimum wage

params.name: penalty
params.description: Statutory remedy for an unlawful deduction

params.name: notes
params.description: Caps, timing, revocation and other wrinkles

obligations.name: Equal pay
obligations.description: Employees doing the same or comparable work may not be paid differently because of a protected characteristic; some states also protect employees who discuss wages.

params.name: comparison_standard
params.description: How alike two jobs must be for a pay difference to need a lawful justification; discrimination_statute_only means pay bias is reached only through the general anti-discrimination law

params.name: protected_classes
params.description: Characteristics the pay comparison protects

params.name: min_employees
params.description: Employer size at which the law attaches

params.name: pay_secrecy_prohibited
params.description: Whether the state bars employers from forbidding or punishing wage discussions

params.name: notes
params.description: Lawful justifications, remedies and recent amendments

obligations.name: Hours-worked standard
obligations.description: Which definition of compensable time governs in the jurisdiction: the FLSA with its Portal-to-Portal exclusions, a state regulation of its own, or a control test that counts any time under the employer's control.

params.name: standard
params.description: flsa_by_reference: the state adopts or defers to 29 CFR 785; state_regulation: the state has its own hours-worked rule (often close to federal but without some exclusions); control_test: any time subject to the employer's control is paid; no_state_law: only the FLSA applies

params.name: portal_to_portal_adopted
params.description: Whether the state excludes ordinary commuting and pre/post-shift activities the way 29 U.S.C. §254 does

params.name: de_minimis_allowed
params.description: Whether small amounts of off-the-clock time may be disregarded

params.name: notes
params.description: Where the state departs from federal law

obligations.name: Compensable travel time
obligations.description: Whether a kind of travel counts as hours worked.

params.name: compensable
params.description: Whether the travel must be paid

params.name: travel_type
params.description: The travel situation the rule decides

params.name: during_normal_hours_only
params.description: Whether only travel that overlaps the employee's normal working hours (including on non-working days) is paid

params.name: minimum_wage_rate_allowed
params.description: Whether the employer may pay travel at an agreed rate as low as the minimum wage instead of the regular rate

params.name: distance_threshold_miles
params.description: Distance beyond which the travel becomes compensable

params.name: notes
params.description: Exceptions and the governing test

obligations.name: Compensable waiting and on-call time
